purpose: Keep worker support from collapsing into individual self-care tips.

support_forms.caution: peer support is useful for some teams but cannot replace qualified support when needed
debriefs can support reflection and learning but should not become compulsory exposure or performance
ritual is workplace/culture-dependent and not a universal prescription
workload, scheduling, recognition, and leadership are part of the burden surface
phrases like professional distance or bounce back can protect or erase

not_advice: This matrix does not tell a workplace what program to implement; it preserves source-supported support vocabulary and review obligations.
